TARUN CHANDRA Software Engineer | Backend | Microservices

7676359198 | tarunchandratc1998@gmail.com | Bengaluru, Karnataka LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/tarunchandra1998/ | GitHub:github.com/tarunchandra1998

Professional Summary

Software Engineer with 4.5+ years of experience designing and building scalable microservices, distributed systems, and event-driven platforms. Proven expertise in Golang, Node.js, Kafka, Python, PostgreSQL, React, and AWS, developing high-throughput applications that process millions of events daily. Experienced in building real-time segmentation, personalization, recommendation, and search platforms using cloud-native architectures on Kubernetes and AWS. Skilled in REST API development, microservices design, observability, and performance optimization, with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Skills

Languages : JavaScript, Golang, SQL Backend & Frameworks : Node.js, Express.js, gRPC, REST API Design, FastAPI, Middleware, Authentication (JWT, OAuth) Frontend: React.js, Redux, Context API, HTML5, CSS3, Responsive UI, Axios, Form Handling Databases & Caching: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis, Indexing, Query Optimization Cloud & DevOps: AWS (EKS, EC2, S3, Lambda, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch) Infrastructure & Orchestration : Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Terraform, CI/CD, Github Actions Monitoring & Observability : Datadog (APM, Logs, Metrics), PagerDuty, Splunk API & Integration: REST APIs, API Gateway, Third-Party API Integrations Tools : Git, GitHub, Bitbucket, JIRA, Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, Agile/Scrum Architecture: Microservices, Event-Driven Systems, Distributed Systems, Scalable Systems, High Availability

Work Experience

Conde Nast Technology Lab (Talent Hivee), Bengaluru

Nov 2024 - July 2026

Software Engineer I

Engineered microservices for Condé Nast’s next generation segmentation, recommendation & search platform, powering 60+ global brands (Vogue, Wired, GQ, The New Yorker) and processing 5M+ events/day.

Built scalable backend microservices using Golang, Node.js, Kafka and PostgreSQL, improving system throughput and enabling near real-time user targeting.

Architected Kafka-based event-driven pipelines to process and classify user events in real time, reducing data processing latency and improving segmentation accuracy.

Optimized data storage and query performance using PostgreSQL and DynamoDB, reducing query latency for high-volume workloads.

Developed internal React dashboards for real-time segmentation insights and campaign targeting, improving data visibility and reducing decision-making time.

Deployed and managed cloud-native services on AWS (EKS, S3, Lambda) using Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform, achieving 99.9% uptime and improved scalability.

Implemented observability and alerting using Datadog and PagerDuty, reducing incident response time and improving production reliability.

Designed end-to-end microservices architecture handling high-concurrency workloads and ensuring system scalability.

Elula Tech Private Limited, Bengaluru

Nov 2022 - Oct 2024

Software Development Engineer

Contributed to ReachShip, a SaaS-based global shipping and logistics platform supporting high-volume shipment processing.

Engineered RESTful APIs and microservices using Golang and Node.js for order and shipment processing, improving system throughput.

Enhanced system scalability by integrating PostgreSQL and MongoDB, reducing data retrieval latency.

Built backend services for real-time shipment tracking and logistics workflow automation, enabling faster status updates and improving operational efficiency.

Developed React-based UI components for shipment tracking dashboards, improving user experience and reducing manual tracking efforts.

Deployed services on AWS (ECS, Lambda, S3) using Docker and Kubernetes, improving system reliability and achieving uptime.

Implemented CI/CD pipelines to automate build, test, and deployment processes, reducing deployment time.

Caplix Technologies, Remote

May 2022 - Nov 2022

Associate Software Engineer

Developed custom web applications for e-commerce and enterprise clients, supporting scalable business workflows. • Designed and implemented RESTful APIs using Node.js, Golang for user management, authentication, and order processing, improving API response time.

Built backend services for inventory, billing, and reporting workflows, enhancing operational efficiency and data accuracy.

Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) for secure admin and user dashboards, improving system security and access management.

Integrated payment gateways and third-party APIs for business operations.

ICICI Prudential, Bilaspur

Feb 2022 - May 2022

Financial Services Consultant

Assisted with customer onboarding, policy documentation, and client support. • Handled customer queries related to insurance and investment products.

Project Work

Segmentation Platform Tech Stack: Golang, Node.js, Kafka, PostgreSQL, AWS EKS, Kubernetes, Terraform

Engineered a real-time user segmentation platform processing millions of events per day using event-driven architecture.

Built Kafka producer and consumer services for dynamic audience targeting and campaign personalization.

Developed real-time segment lookup, reverse lookup, and privacy deletion workflows.

Personalization & Recommendation Platform Tech Stack: Node.js, Golang, Kafka, MongoDB, Redis, DynamoDB, AWS EKS

Developed backend microservices serving personalized content recommendations. ● Leveraged real-time user behavior, segmentation data, and content metadata for personalization. Implemented caching and optimization strategies to improve response times and scalability. ●

Enhanced Semantic Search Platform Tech Stack: Node.js, Python, MongoDB, Redis, OpenAI Embeddings, SageMaker

Built a hybrid search platform supporting semantic search, fuzzy matching, and synonym expansion. Implemented embedding-based retrieval and relevance ranking for large-scale content archives. ●

● Achieved low-latency search responses through intent-aware caching and query optimization.

Verso Publishing Platform Tech Stack: React.js, Redux, GraphQL, SSR, TypeScript

Contributed to a multi-tenant publishing platform supporting multiple Condé Nast brands. ● Developed reusable components, state management solutions, and GraphQL integrations. Improved rendering performance through server-side rendering and frontend optimizations. ●

ReachShip Tech Stack: Golang, Node.js, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, REST APIs

Developed shipping and fulfillment automation services integrating multiple carrier providers. ● ● Built scalable backend services supporting domestic and international shipping operations. Implemented real-time rate calculation, label generation, shipment tracking, and return workflows.

E-Commerce Management System Tech Stack: Node.js, Golang, Python, Express.js, MongoDB, Redis, REST APIs

Designed and developed scalable APIs for product, order, inventory, and payment management. ● ● Supported high-volume transaction processing and administrative workflows. Implemented authentication, authorization, and caching mechanisms.

Education

CSVTU Bhilai (Chhattisgarh)

April 2021

B.Tech (ETC)

Certificates

Full Stack Development Certification – JSpiders May 2021 - Jan 2022
